name: Avoid Programs having a very low Comment/Code ratio (z/OS Assembler)
description:
This quality rule reports all z/OS Assembler Programs with a comment/code ratio lower than X % (by default X=5).
The threshold is a parameter and can be changed at will.
A z/OS Assembler Program is one .asm or .mlc source file. Its comment lines are the comment lines starting with '*' or '.*' and the lines holding remarks written after the operands of a statement.
output:
This report lists all z/OS Assembler Programs with a comment/code ratio lower than X %.
It provides the following information:
- Program full name, comment/code ratio
rationale: Maintainability of the code is facilitated if there is documentation in the code. This rule will ensure there are comments within the Programs.
remediation: Enrich the code of the Programs with comments.
alternativeName: Avoid Programs having a very low Comment/Code ratio (z/OS Assembler)
